rci1_using_msad.detail: Single site (Radboud University Medical Center, Nijmegen); single 1.5T Siemens Magnetom Avanto scanner
rci1_using_msad.supporting_text: "Whole brain imaging was performed using a 1.5 T scanner (Magnetom Avanto, Siemens Medical Systems) with a standard 8-channel head coil."

rci2_using_epd.detail: Reference data from the Dutch cohort of IMpACT (in-house consortium dataset); not included in the 18 EPD list
rci2_using_epd.supporting_text: "We selected adult participants with persistent ADHD and healthy individuals from the Dutch cohort of the International Multicenter persistent ADHD CollaboraTion (IMpACT; Hoogman et al., 2011; Mostert et al., 2015), based on data availability for structural MRI images."

rci3_epd_name.detail: RCI-2 = No; no EPD used; reference data entirely from in-house IMpACT Dutch cohort

rci5_n.detail: Overall healthy individuals; same cohort used for both GM and WM normative models; normative range estimated via 10-fold CV, then final model trained on all 146 HC and applied to ADHD participants
rci5_n.supporting_text: "We included 153 adults with ADHD and 146 healthy adults." "the normative range for this model in healthy individuals was estimated using 10-fold crossvalidation, then we applied the model trained on all healthy individuals to participants with ADHD."
rci5_n.location: Wolfers2020.pdf.md: Results / Participants, L125; Methods / Normative modeling, L107

rci6_sex.detail: Overall HC; male_n estimated from 43.8% of 146 = 64 (64/146 = 43.8%); female_n = 146 - 64 = 82 (82/146 = 56.2%)
rci6_sex.supporting_text: "About the same proportion of individuals in both groups were male (43.8% first and 41.2% second group, respectively)."
